Theorem
[Reduced-volume monotonicity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0133 ↗ def:chow-iii-reduced-volume-strong-collapse 1. ch19:eq-19.58\group Reduced Geometry

For bounded-curvature backward flow, $\widetilde V(\tau )\to 1$ as $\tau \downarrow 0$, it is nonincreasing in $\tau $, and equality at two times occurs exactly for Euclidean space.
